The '''Ambar family''' lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. [[Drexler Ambar]] married [[Keturah Ambar]] and the couple raised seven sons and a daughter. The family ran [[Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop]].<ref name="BSS" />
